QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6
QuestInfo.2: I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can make them stronger. I'll make sure to remember that.

0.0: Wow, you're pretty good. Are you assigning your Ability Points (AP) well? You know you get those after leveling up, right? Talk to me when you're ready for the 6th question.

1.0:
If you keep up with your adventures, you can level up and earn AP to boost your stats. Do you know how much AP you get with each level?

#L0# #b1 point
#L1# 2 points
#L2 # 5 points#k#l
1.1: That's right. You get 5 AP with each level, and you can use them on the stats you want in Character Info to make your character stronger. Be sure to remember that!

0.0: Come on, you get more than 1 measly point!
